transcript: After 40 you should only care about your peace of mind, sleeping good, traveling and enjoying life. At a certain age drama starts looking childish and peace starts looking rich. You begin to understand that not every argument deserves your energy. Not every opinion deserves your reaction. Not every person deserves access to your spirit. The older you become, the more you value calm mornings, quiet dinners, deep sleep, good health and freedom. Because true wealth is not just money, it is having a mind that feels still, a heart that feels light and a life that no longer feels rushed. At this age, if it does not bring peace, profit or purpose, it is too expensive for your soul. If you are trying to reconnect with yourself and find peace again, my 30 day healing journey is waiting for you in the link on my profile.
